title: A 4-Inch Mouse Eats North America's Most Venomous Scorpion

scenes.text: A four-inch mouse eats the deadliest scorpion in North America.
The bark scorpion's sting should be deadly to an animal that small.
But in the grasshopper mouse, the venom shuts down the pain instead.
One tiny change in a pain protein flips the sting into a painkiller.
The mouse licks the wound, then eats the scorpion, and it howls before it attacks.
The scorpion's best weapon is its dinner's painkiller.

description:
The southern grasshopper mouse eats bark scorpions, the most venomous scorpions in North America, and the venom barely hurts it.
A small change in one pain protein turns the venom into a painkiller.
Would you take on a scorpion?
first_comment: It howls before it attacks. Would you want this mouse as a pet?
